_comment: Example operator configuration. One of the 6 frozen combinations, verbatim. Changing any value will be REJECTED by config_validator.validate() and by the MQL5 EA's ValidateFrozenConfig().
_note_on_choice: USDJPY/SPX500/240M carries the strongest train-side signal of the 6 frozen combinations (t=+7.31, n=121) but is STILL VALIDATION_UNDERPOWERED (val n=23, need 30). It is shown here as the example only because it is the most-discussed candidate in the research reports, NOT because it is recommended for live use.
